messages:
noah: hey folks, i'm Noah — first day on infra. quick map request: i'm deploying a private model endpoint and need VPC + service creds, DNS/ingress certs, and access to the Dedicated usage dashboards. who owns each piece and what's the paging/escalation path if something breaks during setup? also curious who approves Dedicated capacity for a new project. thanks! :wave:

onboarding-bot: welcome @noah! Start here: https://redwood.internal/onboard/dev-infra. For access requests use the infra-access Jira template. If you need immediate help, see the oncall contact in the handbook.

marta: short answers: VPC/subnet/cidr -> eng-infra. service credentials (service principals/roles) -> identity team (open id portal ticket). DNS + certs for private endpoints -> infra-dns. Dedicated capacity provisioning and billing scopes -> finance-ops + infra lead signoff.

eng-sre: paging rules: page `eng-sre-oncall` for service-level incidents (errors, latency spikes, degraded SLOs). Page `infra-ops` for provisioning, network flaps, and capacity issues. If you only have a config question, create an infra-access ticket and tag `eng-sre` to request a runbook check. For rollouts, eng-sre will want a short blameless checklist.

infra-dns: DNS/cert requests: include hostname, intended audience (internal-only or hybrid), and cert lifetime. Example snippet for ticket:
```
Hostnames: model-prod.private.redwood.internal
Type: internal
Cert: Let's Encrypt (internal CA)
Owner: noah
Canary: yes (10%)
```
We handle cert provisioning after subnet/VPN is ready.

finance-ops: for dashboard/billing-read access request `billing-read` in ID portal and add cost-center + approver. Dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs) needs a cost commitment approval. Start with a request to `infra-leads` and finance will review for budget alignment.

noah: awesome — for pages, can you confirm phone vs slack? and is there a pref for paging eng-sre first vs infra-ops? want to avoid noisy escalations during canaries.

marta: prefer slack pager for initial triage (`/pager eng-sre-oncall <one-line>`). Phone call only if P0 or if the page doesn't get ack in 10 minutes. For canaries: page eng-sre first, they'll route to infra if it's infra-rooted. include runbook link and telemetry (prometheus dashboard link) in the page.

eng-sre: add one more: if this is model-related, include your eval prompt set and baseline metrics in the ticket so we can add regression guards to the SLO checks.

noah: perfect, i'll open infra-access with subnet + dns + cert details, request billing-read, and cc `eng-sre` and `finance-ops`. thanks all! :thumbsup:
